attempts.subject: S4 Manipulating Rational Expressions

S4.a.description: Multiply and divide rational expressions (Q6a, Q6b, Q7, Q8)

S4.b.description: Add and subtract rational expressions with LCD (Q6c, Q9, Q10, Q11)

S5.d.description: Simplify rational expressions (Q2, Q3, Q4, Q5, Q13)

other.description: Error analysis and difference quotient (Q1, Q14)

q2.note: Factoring error: wrote x(x+2) instead of x(x+1). Prevented cancellation. Correct: x/(x-1).

q6c.note: LCD or multiplier error when adding 1/(4x⁴)+1/(2x²). Correct: (2x²+1)/(4x⁴).

q7.note: Factored x²-6x+8 as (x-3)² instead of (x-4)(x-2). Arithmetic error on constant term (9 vs 8). Correct: 3x/(3x+5).

q8.note: Teacher marked wrong. Method flagged 'illegit!' — used shortcut instead of proper factoring approach.

q10.note: Sign distribution error: didn't negate all terms when subtracting. Correct: (7x+5)/((x+1)(x+4)).

q11.problem: Which is equivalent to 1/(x+2)+1/(x+3) for x>3?
q11.note: Correct: A = (2x+5)/(x²+5x+6). Kai made arithmetic error when checking by substitution.

q13.note: CRITICAL: Did not factor. Tried to cancel individual terms (x³→x, x²→1) instead of factoring h=x(x-3)(x+3), k=(x-3)(x+1). Correct: x(x+3)/(x+1).

q14.note: Distribution error: dropped the 2 when expanding 2(x²+2xh+h²), getting 2x²+2xh+h² instead of 2x²+4xh+2h². Correct: 4x+2h-3.

attempts.error_analysis: 7/15 (47%). Teacher grade: 3/4. Three distinct error patterns: (1) FACTORING — Q2 wrong factor, Q5 expansion error, Q7 arithmetic on constant, Q8 illegitimate method, Q13 didn't factor at all (tried term-by-term cancellation, fundamental misconception). (2) SIGN DISTRIBUTION — Q10 forgot to negate all terms, Q14 dropped coefficient when distributing. (3) LCD CONSTRUCTION — Q6c wrong multiplier, Q11 couldn't combine unit fractions. Multiply/divide (S4.a) needs work. Add/subtract (S4.b) is critical at 25%. Simplification (S5.d) is weak. Q13 is the most concerning: term-by-term cancellation instead of factoring shows a conceptual gap, not just a careless mistake.
